name: fix_makefile_missing_build_dependency
description: test/lint targets don't depend on build, so `make test` can run against a stale image; add .PHONY, the build prerequisite, and a ci composite target - proven by real `make -n` dry-run ordering
prompts: This Makefile's test and lint targets run `docker run --rm $(IMAGE) ...` directly, with no dependency on build - so `make test` silently runs against whatever image tag already exists (stale, or missing entirely on a clean checkout), never rebuilding first. Fix it: add a `.PHONY` declaration listing every non-file target (build test lint clean, plus the new one below), make BOTH test and lint depend on build, and add a `ci` target that depends on lint and test (in that order) so a single `make ci` runs the whole gate. Keep the build/test/lint/clean recipes themselves unchanged.

setup_files.Makefile:
IMAGE := reportgen:local

build:
	docker build -t $(IMAGE) .

test:
	docker run --rm $(IMAGE) pytest -q

lint:
	docker run --rm $(IMAGE) ruff check .

clean:
	docker rmi $(IMAGE) 2>/dev/null || true

test_setup_files.check_makefile.py:
import re
import subprocess

content = open("Makefile", encoding="utf-8").read()

phony_lines = [l for l in content.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith(".PHONY")]
assert phony_lines, "no .PHONY declaration"
phony_targets = set(phony_lines[0].split(":", 1)[1].split())
for t in ("build", "test", "lint", "clean"):
    assert t in phony_targets, f"{t} missing from .PHONY"

def prereqs(target):
    m = re.search(rf"(?m)^{re.escape(target)}\s*:(.*)$", content)
    assert m, f"target {target!r} not found"
    return set(m.group(1).split())

assert "build" in prereqs("test"), (
    "the test target must depend on build - otherwise `make test` can run "
    "against a stale or missing image")
assert "build" in prereqs("lint"), "the lint target must depend on build"

# `ci` must be a real composite target
ci_prereqs = prereqs("ci")
assert {"lint", "test"} <= ci_prereqs, "ci must depend on both lint and test"

# make -n (dry run) must not error, and must show the build step exactly
# once ahead of the test recipe for `make test` (real dependency ordering)
dry = subprocess.run(["make", "-n", "test"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
assert dry.returncode == 0, f"make -n test failed:\n{dry.stdout}\n{dry.stderr}"
lines = [l for l in dry.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip()]
assert any("docker build" in l for l in lines), (
    "`make -n test` never shows the build step - test does not actually depend on build")
build_idx = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if "docker build" in l)
test_idx = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if "pytest" in l)
assert build_idx < test_idx, "build must run BEFORE the test recipe"

print("PASS Makefile dependency checks")
